user.title: Nightlife Connect guide
user.lead: See where the vibe is right now, meet people before and during the night and go out more safely. This is how it works.

items.map: Live map with the venues and events in your city and how many people are at each one.
items.stats: At each place you see people, average age and share in green. It is always aggregated and anonymous: with fewer than 5 people you only see "Fewer than 5".
items.search: Search and every filter for free: venue type, open now, price, distance and more.
items.place: Each venue page shows opening hours, price, address, the Vibe Check and lost & found. Save it to your favourites to come back.
items.venueSays: «The venue says»: some venues publish their photos (reviewed by Nightlife), how the door is, tonight's offers, dress code and prices. It is always marked as coming from the venue itself.
items.bookings: Bookings and guest lists: at venues that offer them you can request a table (no payment; the venue accepts or declines) or join tonight's list and get in with your QR. You need a verified age; the venue only sees your profile name.

items.going: "Going Tonight": say where you are going to meet people who are going too.
items.here: "I'm Here": check in when you are less than 150 m from the venue. It expires by itself after a few hours.
items.swipe: See profiles of people at the same place or going there; first, whoever is with you right now.

items.match: If you both like each other it's a match and a real-time chat opens.
items.light: Traffic light: green, open to dating; yellow, friendship only; red, you don't appear in profiles.
items.discreet: Discreet mode: you count in the stats but don't appear in the lists of who is going or who is there.
items.control: You can remove a match, block or report anyone at any time.

items.phone: Your phone is verified with an SMS when you sign up. One account per phone.
items.age: To see profiles, like, chat, mark that you are going, check in visibly or create events you need to verify you are an adult. Exploring the map, events and stats does not need it.
items.badges: Verified photo and verified identity are optional and give you a badge. We only keep the result, never your documents or selfies.

items.sos: SOS: call 112 or alert up to 3 trusted contacts from Profile › SOS.
items.report: Report profiles, events or messages. A person reviews every case and you can appeal decisions.
items.rules: The Community Guidelines apply to everyone; accounts that break them are suspended.

items.create: With your age verified you can create up to 2 events a day in public places.
items.confirm: Events by users show as "Unconfirmed" until 3 people confirm they exist; events by venues show as "Official".
items.vibe: Vibe Check: once checked in at a place you can vote on tonight's atmosphere.
items.lost: Lost & found: post or answer notices for the venue for 48 hours.
items.live: How it is now: with a check-in, tap to say how busy it is, the queue or what music is playing; you see the anonymous summary of the last 90 minutes and what the venue declares.

items.core: Map, stats, events, search and every filter.
items.people: Full profiles, chatting with your matches and 5 likes a day.
items.trust: Every verification and every safety tool.

items.pass: Pass ({{passMonthly}} a month, {{passQuarterly}} a quarter or {{passAnnual}} a year): unlimited likes, undo the last swipe, extra themes and no sponsored cards.
items.vip: VIP Pass ({{vip}} a month): everything in the Pass plus who liked you, priority, incognito mode and, every week, 1 Spotlight, 3 Sparks and 2 Direct messages.
items.night: One-night Pass ({{oneNight}}, one-off payment): the Pass benefits until 06:00 and 1 Spotlight.
items.extras: One-offs (one-off payment; credits never expire): Spark, a highlighted like with an anonymous notice ({{spark1}}; 5 for {{spark5}}; 15 for {{spark15}}); Spotlight, 30 minutes featured at your venue or area ({{spotlight}}); and Direct message, to write before matching and never to someone on red ({{paidDm}}).
items.status: These are testing-phase prices, VAT included: they may change before launch and nothing real is charged now. The basics and safety are and will stay free.

payments.title: How you pay, cancel and withdraw

items.buy: Buy in Profile › Premium. Before paying you see the price with VAT and the terms; a secure gateway (Stripe) handles the payment and we never see your card.
items.renew: Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each period. Cancel any time in Profile › My subscription: you keep the perks until the end of the paid period.
items.withdraw: You can withdraw within 14 days of purchase from My subscription. What you have already used is not refunded; you will see the amount before confirming. More details in the Premium Terms.
items.promo: Got a promo code? Redeem it in Premium › Redeem code.

items.location: We never show your exact location to anyone.
items.consents: Every permission starts off: you decide what to turn on and can change it in Profile › Consents.
items.data: Download or delete your data whenever you want from Profile › Privacy and data.

items.signup: Sign up in a few minutes: date of birth, signing the documents, phone with SMS, permissions, profile and theme.
items.login: To come back use "I already have an account". Soon you will also be able to sign in with a code to your verified email, no SMS.
items.loginEmail: To come back use "I already have an account": with a code to your verified email (no SMS) or with SMS. Add your email in Profile › Settings › Account.
items.delete: You can sign out or delete your account whenever you want.

venues.title: Guide for venues
venues.lead: Nightlife Connect puts your venue in front of people deciding where to go out tonight. This is what you can do.

items.claim: Sign up in the app and go to Profile › Venue panel › Claim a venue.
items.evidence: Tell us how you prove you manage it (for example, tax ID, an invoice in the venue's name or an email on its domain).
items.review: A person on the team reviews every request. Once approved, you manage the page from your panel.
items.help: Would you rather we help you? Write to us from Contact.
items.invite: If you sign an agreement with us, we send you an invitation: you sign in, accept the venue terms and manage the venue without claiming it.

items.profile: Edit your page: description, opening hours and price range.
items.events: Publish official events: they show as "Official" without waiting for confirmations.
items.stats: Basic stats: check-ins this week and how many people are going tonight, always aggregated and anonymous.
items.music: Music and atmosphere: declare up to 3 styles and tonight's line-up; the venue page shows it next to what checked-in people vote (anonymous, from 3 votes). Managers cannot vote at their own venue.
items.team: Team: the owner can invite and remove managers; everyone sees the plan and the active advantages of the venue.
items.photos: Photos: up to 3 for free (cover included) and up to 10 with a sponsorship or Pro stats. They go live after review and are uploaded without location data.
items.live: Live: say whether there is a queue or it is full (lasts 90 minutes) and offers like «free entry until» or «happy hour until». It shows as «The venue says».
items.details: Extra details: dress code, minimum age, entry and drink prices, terrace and accessibility.
items.report: Results: your page views, «I'm going» and check-ins over the last 30 days and the effect of your sponsorships and Flash. Always aggregated (fewer than 5 people is never shown). With Pro stats, night-by-night trends.
items.bookings: Bookings and lists (free): accept or decline table requests and open a list for the night with places and a time limit. At the door each QR or code works once. You only see the profile name, party size and time.

items.featured: Featured ({{featured}} for 30 days): your pin highlighted on the map of your area and a card for your venue among the profiles.
items.plus: Featured Plus ({{featuredPlus}} for 30 days): also, top positions in the lists that match each person's filters.
items.top: Top ({{top}} for 30 days): shown before Plus and adds Flash Alerts to announce a promotion for one hour.
items.limits: There are 3 places per city. Book it from your panel: choose the level and start date and pay by card (one-off payment, no automatic renewal) or ask for an invoice and we activate it once paid.
items.contract: With an agreement with Nightlife (contract), your sponsorship level and/or Pro stats are active during the contract dates, at a price agreed outside the app. You see it in your panel under «Plan and perks», and it does not take places in your city.

items.detail: Footfall by hour, average age, traffic light and comparison with venues in your area.
items.privacy: Always aggregated data: small groups are never shown.
items.billing: Monthly subscription per venue ({{pro}} a month) that renews automatically. Cancel it from the billing portal and keep access until the end of the period; only the account that bought it manages it.

items.what: In-app notices that last one hour, for venues with a Top sponsorship.
items.audience: Only age-verified people who agreed to receive promotions see them.
items.alcohol: Alcohol promotions are off until the rules of each region have been reviewed.

items.label: Sponsored content always carries the "Sponsored" label.
items.data: Paying never changes the data: people, average age and atmosphere are real.
items.filters: A sponsored venue only appears if it matches the searcher's filters, and slots are limited.

items.now: These are testing-phase amounts: they may change before launch and nothing real is charged now.
items.refunds: As this is a business-to-business contract there is no right of withdrawal; for any issue, write to us from Contact.
